correctness.rationale: Starting from the published facet inequalities, the normalized simplex-tail identity is exact. Inclusion–exclusion through pair caps, exact integration of pair-facet violations, Bonferroni overlap bounds and beta-tail bounds on all rank >=3 facets give the stated O_n(m^(2n-3) C^m) remainder. The (B-1)^m terms cancel algebraically, and C<B proves the ratio limit. The finite numerical checks of one-pair volumes and low-dimensional convex hulls passed; they are not substituted for proof.

originality.rationale: The original 2022 primary paper, fully inspected at its relevant facet and volume sections, provides precise motivation and conjectures an n>4 decomposition but does not establish this two-correction theorem for every fixed n>=5. A separate 2026 full-text study addresses magic positivity, and the 2023 full-text volume treatment of generalized parking-function polytopes applies to a different regime. Relevant indexed research records are about inradii, circumradii, diameter or angular geometry; statement-level implication comparison finds no covering claim. Residual risk: unindexed equivalent geometric inclusion-exclusion derivation.
residual_risks: Full independent bibliographic search of every unindexed treatment is impossible; an equivalent asymptotic argument could exist in unindexed or recently posted work.
Conjecture 5.15 remains unproved in full; it is evidence of the problem motivation, not a premise.

value.rationale: Problem 5.14 of the primary study explicitly leaves fixed label bounds n>4 without general exact volumes. The new symbolic expansion identifies the first three exponential layers for all fixed n>=5, including the exact previously undetermined second correction coefficient and a remainder at the next conjectured scale. This gives useful, non-table asymptotic structure while not purporting to solve full enumeration.
